questions.prompt: 画抛物线并指出顶点、焦点、准线及轴：(a) $x^2=-8y$；(b) $y^2=5x$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 比较标准式的系数，取带符号的 $p=-2$，顶点为 $(0,0)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 从顶点沿轴移动 $p$ 得焦点 $(0,-2)$，向反方向移动同样距离得准线 $y=2$。通径垂直于轴，长 $4|p|=8$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 比较标准式的系数，取带符号的 $p=\frac{5}{4}$，顶点为 $(0,0)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 从顶点沿轴移动 $p$ 得焦点 $(\frac{5}{4},0)$，向反方向移动同样距离得准线 $x=- \frac{5}{4}$。通径垂直于轴，长 $4|p|=5$。

en.prompt: Graph and specify vertex, focus, directrix and axis: (a) $x^2=-8y$; (b) $y^2=5x$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Compare with standard form to obtain the signed parameter $p=-2$ and vertex $(0,0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(0,-2)$. The directrix $y=2$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=8$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Compare with standard form to obtain the signed parameter $p=\frac{5}{4}$ and vertex $(0,0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(\frac{5}{4},0)$. The directrix $x=- \frac{5}{4}$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=5$.

en.answer: (a) Standard form $x^{2}=- 8 y$; vertex $(0,0)$; focus $(0,-2)$; directrix $y=2$; axis $x=0$; focal diameter $8$. (b) Standard form $y^{2}=5 x$; vertex $(0,0)$; focus $(\frac{5}{4},0)$; directrix $x=- \frac{5}{4}$; axis $y=0$; focal diameter $5$.
en.label: Example 1

en.prompt: Find the standard equation and focal diameter: (a) focus $(0,5)$, directrix $y=-3$; (b) vertex $(-1,2)$, directrix $x=2$; (c) vertex $(-5,-2)$, focus $(1,-2)$.

steps.title: Use the given conditions
steps.body: (a) The vertex is halfway from the focus to its perpendicular foot on the directrix. (b) The signed vertex-to-directrix displacement is opposite the focal displacement. (c) Subtract vertex from focus to determine p.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Compare with standard form to obtain the signed parameter $p=4$ and vertex $(0,1)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(0,5)$. The directrix $y=-3$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=16$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(-4,2)$. The directrix $x=2$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=12$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason

en.answer: (a) Standard form $x^{2}=16 y - 16$; vertex $(0,1)$; focus $(0,5)$; directrix $y=-3$; axis $x=0$; focal diameter $16$. (b) Standard form $\left(y - 2\right)^{2}=- 12 x - 12$; vertex $(-1,2)$; focus $(-4,2)$; directrix $x=2$; axis $y=2$; focal diameter $12$. (c) Standard form $\left(y + 2\right)^{2}=24 x + 120$; vertex $(-5,-2)$; focus $(1,-2)$; directrix $x=-11$; axis $y=-2$; focal diameter $24$.

questions.prompt: 求 $2y^2-8y-x+7=0$ 的顶点、焦点、准线并画图。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 比较标准式的系数，取带符号的 $p=\frac{1}{8}$，顶点为 $(-1,2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 从顶点沿轴移动 $p$ 得焦点 $(- \frac{7}{8},2)$，向反方向移动同样距离得准线 $x=- \frac{9}{8}$。通径垂直于轴，长 $4|p|=\frac{1}{2}$。

en.prompt: Find the vertex, focus and directrix of $2y^2-8y-x+7=0$ and sketch its graph.

steps.title: Complete the square
steps.body: Write $2(y^2-4y)=x-7$ and add $8$ to both sides to obtain $2(y-2)^2=x+1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Compare with standard form to obtain the signed parameter $p=\frac{1}{8}$ and vertex $(-1,2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(- \frac{7}{8},2)$. The directrix $x=- \frac{9}{8}$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=\frac{1}{2}$.

en.answer: Standard form $\left(y - 2\right)^{2}=\frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{2}$; vertex $(-1,2)$; focus $(- \frac{7}{8},2)$; directrix $x=- \frac{9}{8}$; axis $y=2$; focal diameter $\frac{1}{2}$.
en.label: Example 5

en.prompt: A parabolic mirror is 94.5 inches across and its focus is 2304 inches from the vertex. Find an equation and its depth at the rim. This models the Hubble Space Telescope mirror.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Place the vertex at the origin and the focus at $(0,2304)$, giving $x^2=9216y$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: At the rim $x=\frac{189}{4}$, half the diameter, so the depth is $y=\frac{3969}{16384}\approx 0.242249$ inches.

en.answer: $x^2=9216y$; rim depth approximately 0.2422 inches.

en.prompt: Show that the tangent to $x=4py^2$ at $(x_1,y_1)$ is $y=\frac{x}{8py_1}+\frac{y_1}{2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use $x_1=4py_1^2$. Exchanging x and y in the previous discriminant derivation gives $x=8py_1y-x_1$.

exercises.prompt: 原题写 $y=4px^2$、焦点 $F=(0,p)$、准线 $y=-p$。按图设切线 AP，(a) 证明 $d(F,A)=d(P,F)=p+y_1$ 并说明底角相等及所述构造；(b) 说明切线与轴、与过 P 的轴平行线所成角相等。原题三个条件并不普遍相容，见解析。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 原式 $y=4px^2$ 的实际焦点为 $(0,1/(16p))$。它与所写焦点一致只在 $p=1/4$（按图 p>0）成立。以下是明确的条件性读法：保留焦点、准线及图，改用 $x^2=4py$，不冒称原式无误。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 对 $x^2=4py$，切线 $2py=x_1x-2py_1$ 在 y 轴交于 $A=(0,-y_1)$，故 $FA=p+y_1$。距离定义给 $PF=p+y_1$，所以三角形 FAP 等腰，底角相等。$B=(0,y_1)$，$V=(0,0)$，有 $BV=AV=y_1$，正是所述构造。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) y 轴与 $x=x_1$ 平行，因此被 AP 截出的对应锐角相等，再结合等腰三角形角关系即得反射性质。顶点处用水平切线直接验证，避免退化三角形。

exercises.answer: 原文条件存在不一致。条件性采用 $x^2=4py,p>0$ 时 (a)(b) 成立；不能把它当作原式对任意 p 的证明。

en.prompt: The source states $y=4px^2$, focus $F=(0,p)$ and directrix $y=-p$. With tangent AP, (a) show $d(F,A)=d(P,F)=p+y_1$, conclude equal base angles and justify the construction; (b) compare angles with the axis and a parallel through P. The stated equation and focal data are generally inconsistent; see the solution.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The actual focus of $y=4px^2$ is $(0,1/(16p))$. For p>0 this matches the stated focus only when $p=1/4$. The following is an explicit conditional reading: retain the focal data and diagram and use $x^2=4py$; this is not asserted to be the equation as printed.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) For $x^2=4py$, the tangent $2py=x_1x-2py_1$ meets the y-axis at $A=(0,-y_1)$, so $FA=p+y_1$. The distance definition gives $PF=p+y_1$; triangle FAP is isosceles and its base angles agree. With $B=(0,y_1)$ and $V=(0,0)$, $BV=AV=y_1$, justifying the construction.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The y-axis and $x=x_1$ are parallel, so their corresponding acute angles with AP agree. Combining this with the isosceles triangle proves reflection. At the vertex, use the horizontal tangent directly rather than a degenerate triangle.

en.answer: The printed conditions are inconsistent. Under the explicitly corrected interpretation $x^2=4py,p>0$, both claims follow; they do not prove the printed formula for arbitrary p.

exercises.prompt: 求抛物线 $x^2-2x-12y+25=0$ 顶点与通径端点组成的三角形面积。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 比较标准式的系数，取带符号的 $p=3$，顶点为 $(1,2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 从顶点沿轴移动 $p$ 得焦点 $(1,5)$，向反方向移动同样距离得准线 $y=-1$。通径垂直于轴，长 $4|p|=12$。

steps.title: 三角形面积
steps.body: 通径长 $12$，顶点到通径的高为 $3$，面积 $\frac12\cdot12\cdot3=18$。

en.prompt: Find the area of the triangle joining the vertex and the latus-rectum endpoints of $x^2-2x-12y+25=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Compare with standard form to obtain the signed parameter $p=3$ and vertex $(1,2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Move by signed distance $p$ from the vertex along the axis to obtain focus $(1,5)$. The directrix $y=-1$ is equally far on the opposite side. The latus rectum is perpendicular to the axis and has length $4|p|=12$.

steps.title: Triangle area
steps.body: The base is the latus rectum, length $12$, and the height from the vertex is $3$. Thus the area is $\frac12\cdot12\cdot3=18$.

en.answer: 18 square units.

exercises.prompt: 等边三角形内接于 $y^2=4px$，且一个顶点为抛物线顶点。求 (a) 边长；(b) 面积。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 另外两点关于轴对称，设为 $(u,\pm v)$。等边条件 $u^2+v^2=(2v)^2$，故 $u^2=3v^2$，结合 $v^2=4pu$ 得非零 $u=12p$，$|v|=4\sqrt3|p|$。

en.prompt: An equilateral triangle is inscribed in $y^2=4px$, with one vertex at the parabola vertex. Find (a) side length and (b) area.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The other vertices are symmetric, $(u,\pm v)$. Equilateral sides require $u^2+v^2=(2v)^2$, so $u^2=3v^2$. Together with $v^2=4pu$, the nonzero solution is $u=12p$, $|v|=4\sqrt3|p|$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) The side is $2|v|=8\sqrt3|p|$; (b) the area is $\frac12(2|v|)|u|=48\sqrt3p^2$.

en.answer: (a) $8\sqrt3|p|$; (b) $48\sqrt3p^2$, with $p\ne0$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 抛物线总是函数图像吗？说明。(b) 要保证抛物线是 y 关于 x 的函数，其准线斜率可能是什么？

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 否。例如 $y^2=x$ 对 x>0 有两个 y，未通过垂线检验。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 只有水平准线，即斜率 0。此时轴竖直，抛物线形如 $y=a(x-h)^2+k$。若轴倾斜或水平，参数曲线的 x 分量为非单调二次式或横轴开口式，某些竖线截两点。

en.prompt: (a) Is a parabola always the graph of a function? Explain. (b) Find all slopes of the directrix for which the parabola is a graph of y as a function of x.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) No. For example, $y^2=x$ gives two y values for x>0 and fails the vertical-line test.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Only a horizontal directrix, of slope 0. The axis is then vertical and the parabola has form $y=a(x-h)^2+k$. For any nonvertical axis, the x component of a standard parameterization is a nonmonotone quadratic, producing vertical lines with two intersections.

exercises.prompt: 画出 $y^2=4kx$ 在 $k=\pm1,\pm2,\pm3$ 时的曲线，说明共同特征。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: k 为正向右，为负向左，顶点全在原点，轴均为 x 轴，通径长为 $4|k|$。

exercises.answer: 共同顶点 $(0,0)$ 和对称轴 $y=0$；|k| 越大开口越宽。

en.prompt: Sketch $y^2=4kx$ for $k=\pm1,\pm2,\pm3$, and state the common characteristic.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Positive k opens right and negative k opens left. Every vertex is the origin, every axis is the x-axis, and the focal diameter is $4|k|$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The solution graphs show k=-3,-2,-1,1,2,3, in that order.

en.answer: Common vertex $(0,0)$ and axis $y=0$; larger |k| gives a wider opening.

exercises.prompt: 用点线距离求焦点 $(4,5)$、准线 $3x+4y=7$ 的抛物线方程及轴。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 距离相等给 $\sqrt{(x-4)^2+(y-5)^2}=|3x+4y-7|/5$。两边非负，可平方而不引入额外点。

en.prompt: Use the point-to-line distance formula for a parabola with focus $(4,5)$ and directrix $3x+4y=7$. Find its equation and axis.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Equal distances give $\sqrt{(x-4)^2+(y-5)^2}=|3x+4y-7|/5$. Both sides are nonnegative, so squaring is reversible.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $25[(x-4)^2+(y-5)^2]=(3x+4y-7)^2$. The axis passes through the focus in the normal direction $(3,4)$, giving $y-5=\frac43(x-4)$.

en.prompt: Find the focus given vertex $(6,-3)$ and directrix $3x-5y+1=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The normal is $(3,-5)$. The perpendicular foot from the vertex to the directrix is $(6,-3)-\frac{34}{34}(3,-5)=(3,2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The vertex is the midpoint of the foot and focus, so the focus is $2(6,-3)-(3,2)=(9,-8)$.
